body.purpose: All text, in the terminal's own font.

emphasis.purpose: Selection, titles, unread items, key names.

motion.name: toast-ttl
motion.purpose: Non-failure toasts expire; failures stay until esc.

narrative.overview: Every piece of work is a line on a metro diagram: stations are stages (or worktrees), the current one is the train, and who must act is printed beside it. ADE inherits the terminal's ground, ink and font; colour is quarantined to line inks and state marks; glyphs are the icon system with an ASCII fallback.
keyCharacteristics: Terminal ground, ink and font are the user's
Colour only as line inks and state marks
Bold for selection and what needs you, faint for metadata
Guide words on section rules; borders only on overlays

rules.name: The Quarantine Rule
rules.body: Colour lives only in line inks and state marks.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: No state is colour alone: glyph plus word, so NO_COLOR loses nothing.

rules.name: The No-Mid-Word Rule
rules.body: Truncations end in an ellipsis; prose wraps instead.

dos: Draw progress and relationships as station lines in the repo's ink
Test under NO_COLOR=1 and host.glyphs = ascii
donts: Paint a background or choose a font
Use colour outside line inks and state marks
Record no-op status in the inbox
